map.1–10 分怎么打才不失真？: How do I score 1-10 without distorting the result?
map.→ 打开胜任力（模型/评估/发展）工具: -> Open the competency (model / evaluation / development) tool
map.先给每个分数档定义行为锚点（如 7 分＝能独立解决常见问题并沉淀方法），再对照打: First define behavioural anchors for each score band (for example 7 means able to solve common problems independently and turn the approach into a method), then score against them; without anchors, scores run high and fail to discriminate.
map.只能作为自评与初筛参考。正式任用应结合绩效记录、360 评估与组织流程，单次打分: It can only serve as a self-assessment and screening reference. A formal appointment should combine performance records, 360-degree feedback and organisational process; a single score cannot support an HR decision.
map.同一份评分在不同岗位下的差异: How the same score differs across job roles
map.培训规划期汇总团队评分，看哪个维度整体偏低，据此排下季度课程。: During training planning, aggregate team scores to see which dimension is generally low and schedule next quarter's courses accordingly.
map.按六个维度评分并结合岗位类型加权，输出胜任力总分、等级与发展建议，适用于人才盘点: Score across six dimensions, weight them by job type, and output a total competency score, grade and development advice. Suitable for talent reviews, promotion assessment and development planning.
map.晋升评审前由主管按六个维度打分，结合岗位权重（管理/技术/销售）得到加权总分与等: Before a promotion review, the supervisor scores six dimensions and combines them with the job weights (management / technical / sales) to get a weighted total and grade.
map.权重是按什么设定的？: What are the weights based on?
map.社招初筛时快速给出胜任力画像，把低于 6 分的维度标为面试追问重点。: During social recruitment screening, quickly produce a competency profile and mark every dimension below 6 as a focus for interview probing.
map.结果能直接用于晋升决策吗？: Can the result be used directly in a promotion decision?
map.页面内置管理/技术/销售三套经验权重（如技术岗专业知识 30%、问题解决 25%: The page ships with three sets of empirical weights for management, technical and sales roles (for a technical role, professional knowledge 30% and problem solving 25%, for example). Organisations can adjust these to their own competency model and convert by hand.
map.：六维均为 8/7/9/7/7/8：技术岗权重下综合约 8.05（优秀），管理岗: : with the six dimensions at 8/7/9/7/7/8, the technical-role weighting gives an overall of about 8.05 (excellent) and the management-role weighting about 7.60. This suggests the employee is better suited to deep technical work, and moving into management would require strengthening teamwork and execution drive first.
map.：销售岗评分中「创新思维」仅 4 分被标为待提升，综合 6.9 属合格；发展计划: : in the sales role score, "innovative thinking" is only 4 and is flagged as needing improvement, and the overall 6.9 counts as a pass. The development plan should address innovative thinking before discussing promotion, because a low-scoring dimension drags down the credibility of the whole profile.
